# agent-evidence-vocabulary

> A closed, versioned vocabulary for the terms that describe an
> adversarial-execution evidence claim: what an executed artifact attempted,
> what a substrate beneath it observed or refused, from what vantage and how
> directly a claim was obtained, and how much of a declared population it
> covers. Independent systems crosswalk their own claim fields onto these
> terms so that a term means one thing across vendors.

The registry is a single YAML file, and every term in it is meant to land as a
field inside a signed statement. Four terms carry the axis the rest depend on:
`observation_vantage` and `observation_directness` say where a claim was
obtained and how directly; `coverage_denominator` and `does_not_assert` say what
it leaves out, inside the signed bytes. The `spec_anchor` field points at the
adversarial-execution-evidence predicate specification, which is vendored and
versioned in the companion conformance suite.

## Entry points

- [README](https://github.com/probityai/agent-evidence-vocabulary/blob/main/README.md): Scope, why the registry exists, and the file map.
- [vocabulary.yaml](https://github.com/probityai/agent-evidence-vocabulary/blob/main/vocabulary.yaml): The registry itself, CC0-1.0. Each term carries its definition, its grounding mechanism, and where it applies a `why_this_registry` note.
- [Governance](https://github.com/probityai/agent-evidence-vocabulary/blob/main/GOVERNANCE.md): Promotion and demotion rules, merge discipline, and the no-self-grounding-exemption rule that binds the founding maintainer's own systems identically to anyone else's.
- [Contributing](https://github.com/probityai/agent-evidence-vocabulary/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md): How to file a crosswalk, with a worked example that CI runs through the validator.
- [Maintainers](https://github.com/probityai/agent-evidence-vocabulary/blob/main/MAINTAINERS.md): Who maintains the registry and the recusal bar.

## Crosswalks

- [crosswalk/](https://github.com/probityai/agent-evidence-vocabulary/tree/main/crosswalk): Filed crosswalks, one file per system, starting from `TEMPLATE.yaml` there.
- [Validator](https://github.com/probityai/agent-evidence-vocabulary/blob/main/scripts/validate_crosswalks.py): Runs on every change. A file whose shape it does not recognize fails loudly and names the file; nothing is skipped.

## Companion corpus

- [probityai/agent-evidence-vectors](https://github.com/probityai/agent-evidence-vectors): The reference verifier and conformance vector suite for the predicate this vocabulary describes, which is where the terms defined here are actually spoken.

## Identifiers

- Release tag: `v0.3.0`, the version `CITATION.cff` carries.
- Archival DOI: not yet minted. This line is replaced with the DOI when one exists.
- [Citation](https://github.com/probityai/agent-evidence-vocabulary/blob/main/CITATION.cff): The machine-readable citation GitHub renders.
